title: Weekender GS-BIRKIN-01 — Birkin-inspired, scaled up to a travel bag

cards.text: WEEKENDER GS-BIRKIN-01 — BIRKIN-INSPIRED, SCALED UP TO A TRAVEL BAG

cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: The 8/20 Zede airport AI UGC script held word for word, moved into the greenscreen format proven by DC-04 and BLK-01. Angle broadened off summer to just the perfect travel bag. New mechanism: Birkin-inspired silhouette scaled up to travel size, which is already the live PDP's own wording. Creator keyed PiP bottom-left for the whole runtime over full-frame b-roll, burned captions, one continuous VO, 1080x1920. Light Chocolate, $159.99 from $209.99. Estimated runtime ~93s at this creator's measured 162wpm; a marked trim lands ~70s for cold TOF.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: if you're looking for the perfect summer travel bag
Full-bleed hero of the bag on a kitchen counter, a hand reaching in to adjust a strap. Creator keyed small bottom-left. Caption two lines at ~77% down.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
curiosity

THIS IS THE POSITIONING THAT IS DEAD. Summer-locked. Our version opens on the viewer's travel situation instead, with no season attached.

SCRIPT
cards.text: Okay, if you travel at all, I need to show you something.
Bag standing beside a silver roller at the front door, about to leave.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
curiosity

Opens on her situation, not the product. No season anywhere in the read.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I used to check a bag for every single trip,
Bag on the entryway bench with a trench coat beside it.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
recognition

Problem beat. Our bag stays on screen through the whole problem, never a rival product.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: because I could never fit everything into something that also looked good.
Bag on the bed with a packing flatlay, sunglasses beside it.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
frustration

This is the bind the mechanism resolves four beats later. Do not trim this line.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: My old duffel held everything, but it looked like a gym bag.
Bag styled on the bed, elegant.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
frustration

LAW: the dismissal lives in the VO over OUR bag. No duffel, no gym bag, no rival product on screen at any point.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: And my nice bags held basically nothing.
Bag on the sofa, full silhouette, size obvious against the cushions.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
frustration

Scale reads here, which sets up the payoff of 'scaled up' two beats later.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: This is the Weekender from Velantra.
Clean front hero on the console table, full silhouette.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
reveal

TTS feeds the brand as Vell-Ahn-Trah. Plain spelling returns Volantra and kills the take.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It's a Birkin-inspired shape, just scaled up to a travel bag.
Bag sitting on top of a full-size green carry-on. Silhouette dead front-on, size unmistakable against known luggage.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
the click

THE MECHANISM BEAT. The frame carries both halves of the line at once: the silhouette AND the travel scale. Single most important frame in the ad. The word Birkin never enters a generation prompt, it lives in VO and caption only.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So it holds three days of clothes, plus my laptop, my chargers, all of it,
Laptop sliding down into the open bag.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
relief

Claim gets its literal demo. The laptop goes in on screen.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and it keeps its shape whether it's packed full or half empty.
Open bag packed with a knit and jeans, walls standing straight.

cards.title: EMOTION

reassurance

TRIM CANDIDATE 1 for the TOF cut. The frame already proves it without the line.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The whole inside is this soft caramel leather with a big slip pocket,
Hands lowering a knit in, caramel leather interior visible against the canvas.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
sensory

Interior is smooth caramel LEATHER, never cream canvas. Any frame showing a canvas interior is a fail. Pull a dedicated slip-pocket macro if this one reads soft.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: and the top flap just folds back so I can see everything at once.
Open bag, the one-piece flap folded all the way back behind the mouth.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
satisfaction

FLAP MECHANISM LAW: one piece, folded all the way over, inner face showing the handle cutouts and the oval plate. Worth a dedicated pull rather than reusing the beat above.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I packed it for a three day trip and I didn't check a single thing.
Bag beside the roller at the door, packed and ready to go.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
confidence

TRIM CANDIDATE 2 for the TOF cut. The next beat makes the same point harder.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It slides right into the overhead bin, so I walk straight past the bag drop line every time.

cards.title: VISUAL
cards.text: NEW GENERATION. Low angle from the aisle, the closed bag resting inside an open overhead bin, cabin light warm, fits with room to spare. No person in frame.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
smugness

The only asset that does not already exist. No-person product still, so it is frame-first: i2i still plus a slow push-in, never a video engine. Overhead bin is live PDP copy, under-seat is NOT a verified claim.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: I've taken it to three cities in the last two months, and I get stopped about it constantly.
Carry-and-walk shot, hand through both rolled handles. CROP BELOW THE CHIN.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
pride

ONE-CREATOR LOCK: the b-roll model's face must not appear. Crop below the chin or this competes with the keyed presenter. TRIM CANDIDATE 3 is the first half of this line.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: People always ask if it's a designer bag.
Macro, hand resting on the gold turn lock and clasp plates.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
validation

The hardware is what reads as designer, so the frame answers the line. Both clasp plates the same warm gold, no silver.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: There's no logo anywhere on it,
Slow macro across clean leather and canvas, no branding anywhere.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
discernment

There genuinely is no logo, inside or out. This is the anti-logo payoff the avatar buys on.

Live PDP, the four colour swatches: Light Chocolate, Army Green, Dark Chocolate, Black.

consideration

Verified live 8/21. The reference ad's 'two colors' is stale. NOTE: Black is a pre-order shipping mid September, the other three ship now. Put that split in the ad copy, not in her mouth.

Bag on the entry bench with the coat, ready for the next trip.

cards.title: OUR VERSION — GS-BIRKIN-01  ·  Zede 8/20 locked script, three factual fixes, greenscreen format

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: The three script changes
cards.text:
Everything else is the 8/20 Zede script word for word.

1. 'that classic structured shape everyone recognizes' reverts to 'a Birkin-inspired shape, just scaled up to a travel bag'. That hedge was the law-forced replacement for exactly this line, so this is a straight reversal back.

2. 'three colors' becomes 'four colors'. Verified live 8/21.

3. 'an end of summer sale' becomes 'a sale right now', so the asset does not die on 9/1.

cards.title: Why this is a mechanism, not a name-drop
cards.text:
The problem beat states a real bind: capacity and shape have been mutually exclusive for her. The duffel held everything and looked like a gym bag, the nice bags held nothing.

'Birkin-inspired shape, scaled up to a travel bag' resolves that bind in one sentence, and it explains every downstream benefit the script already claims.

It never names Hermes, never quotes a Birkin price, never uses dupe, replica, alternative or knockoff, and never ranks the bag against anything.

cards.title: Already live on our own PDP
cards.text:
The Weekender product description currently reads: 'The structured, Birkin-inspired silhouette, sized for a weekend away.'

So the ad is making itself congruent with the page it clicks to, not introducing a new claim.

The standing house law says Birkin stays out of Velantra copy entirely. That law and the live PDP already contradict each other. Worth resolving the law text so the next build is not re-litigating this.

cards.title: Runtime, flagged
cards.text:
~93s at this creator's measured 162wpm (she read BLK-01 at that rate), against a 41-53s norm for this format.

Do NOT atempo it. That is exactly what produced the robotic take on the men's cut.

Recommendation: ship the full read as a MOF and retargeting asset. Cut the four marked TRIM CANDIDATE lines for a ~70s cold TOF version.

cards.title: Assets
cards.text:
Every beat except the overhead bin pulls from the existing Weekender library. Nothing new needs generating except that one shot, and it is a no-person product still so it stays frame-first.

The main frame is bag and hands only for the entire runtime. The b-roll model's face must never appear, or it competes with the keyed presenter.

cards.title: Production, all validated
cards.text:
No new avatar. Re-drive the existing green creator clip with the new VO through fal sync-lipsync v2 in bounce mode.

Chromakey 0x007A28 / 0.11 / 0.02, DESPILL OFF (0.5 renders a cream sweater visibly pink).

PiP 44% width, bottom-left. Captions capped at 4 words and flushed at terminal punctuation.

VP9 alpha needs -c:v libvpx-vp9 before the webm input or she renders as an opaque green box.

cards.title: Black is a pre-order
cards.text:
The PDP says Black ships mid September 2026, and that Light Chocolate, Army Green and Dark Chocolate ship now.

'Four colors' is true, but if a buyer picks Black expecting it to ship, that is a support ticket.

Recommend the ad copy carries the ship split rather than putting it in her mouth, same call as the sale line on BLK-01.
